card.name: Words in clinical timing and monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: Small words or nouns inside instructions about when to dose, check, or observe, such as 'until blood pressure stabilized', 'second dose on the morning', 'after you've had'. Often the word right before a time or a physiological state.

modes.label: Observation until stable
modes.description: Word after 'until' in instructions to observe or monitor a patient until a measure settles.
modes.example: the patient should be observed under medical supervision for at least two hours and until<< blood>> pressure has stabilized for at least an additional

modes.label: Dose timing
modes.description: Word in schedules saying when a dose or test happens, such as evening before or morning of.
modes.example: the first dose the evening before the colonoscopy and the second<< dose>> on the morning of the colonoscopy

modes.description: Linking word or noun in short care instructions after a reaction.
